generate_model_response.description: Send a prompt to an AI model on OpenRouter and get back its response text.
generate_model_response.display_str_template: Send a prompt to an OpenRouter model.

mock_response.response_text: Here is the response generated for your prompt.

generate_model_response.name: generate_model_response

parameters.description: The prompt or question to send to the AI model.
parameters.name: prompt

parameters.description: The OpenRouter model to use, written as provider/model (for example openai/gpt-4o or anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5). Leave blank to let OpenRouter automatically pick a suitable model for your prompt. Browse all models at https://openrouter.ai/models.
parameters.name: model

model.description: The model that actually generated the response. When the model is left as openrouter/auto, this is the model OpenRouter picked for the prompt.

response_text.description: The text the model generated for your prompt.

description: Connect to OpenRouter to generate AI responses from your choice of models.
